accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes CARD in Andhra Pradesh?
o: State-wide networking of district headquarters and mandals
accepted.x: CARD is the computer-aided registration system of the Registration Department for property documents.
accepted.tq: Identify the department-service pair rather than the similar-sounding e-governance project.
accepted.sec: AP e-governance projects - department + service, vs other states  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which project succeeded e-Seva as a single-window mechanism for Government-to-Citizen service delivery in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: MeeSeva succeeded e-Seva as a single-window G2C delivery mechanism.
accepted.tq: Use the succession relationship to distinguish neighbouring citizen-service platforms.
accepted.sec: AP e-governance projects - department + service, vs other states  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following is correctly matched?

Project — Function
1. AP Online — Web portal for G2C services
2. e-Procurement — Online tendering across departments
3. APSWAN — State-wide area network linking headquarters, districts and mandals
4. e-Office — Paperless file movement

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four pairs are correct: AP Online is a G2C web portal, e-Procurement handles online tenders, APSWAN provides state-wide connectivity, and e-Office enables paperless file movement.
accepted.tq: Match each project with its distinctive service before testing the combination.
accepted.sec: AP e-governance projects - department + service, vs other states  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Registration Service Kendras in Andhra Pradesh are modelled on which of the following, while statutory powers continue to remain with the Sub-Registrar Offices?
accepted.x: Registration Service Kendras provide property-registration services on the Passport Seva Kendra model, but statutory powers remain with the SROs.
accepted.tq: Separate the service-delivery model from the authority retaining statutory powers.
accepted.sec: AP e-governance projects - department + service, vs other states  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which State was the first in India to introduce e-Cabinet as a paperless cabinet system?
accepted.x: Himachal Pradesh was the first State to introduce the paperless e-Cabinet system.
accepted.tq: Apply the state-project association without confusing it with other state digital platforms.
accepted.sec: AP e-governance projects - department + service, vs other states  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:

1. HIMSWAN — Himachal Pradesh
2. Digital Seva Setu — Gujarat
3. Seva One — Karnataka
4. GSWAN — Gujarat

Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: HIMSWAN belongs to Himachal Pradesh; Digital Seva Setu and GSWAN belong to Gujarat; and Seva One is Karnataka's digital citizen-services initiative.
accepted.tq: Start with the state-specific network names and eliminate mixed-state combinations.
accepted.sec: AP e-governance projects - department + service, vs other states  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Digital Seva Setu of Gujarat is associated with which of the following combination of coverage figures?
accepted.x: Digital Seva Setu covers 321 services through 14,078 Gram Panchayats.
accepted.tq: Pair the project with both figures instead of relying on one familiar number.
accepted.sec: AP e-governance projects - department + service, vs other states  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following best describes a Category B service under MeeSeva?
o: A service restricted to property registration
A service available only through a mobile application
A service requiring notice, hearing or field verification
A service issued immediately over the counter without verification
accepted.x: Category B services are statutory services that may require notices, hearings or field verification.
accepted.tq: Identify the category from the procedural requirement rather than from the delivery channel.
accepted.sec: Mee Seva - meaning, service categories, departments, channels, launch  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is characteristic of a Category A MeeSeva service?
o: It can be obtained only through a franchise centre
It is issued over the counter on the spot, such as a certified copy
It requires field verification in every case
It requires a statutory hearing before issue
accepted.x: Category A services are over-the-counter services issued on the spot; certified copies are an example.
accepted.tq: Contrast the immediate over-the-counter category with the verification-based category.
accepted.sec: Mee Seva - meaning, service categories, departments, channels, launch  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following departmental functions under MeeSeva is correctly matched?
o: EDS Department — issuing migration certificates to passed candidates
accepted.x: The EDS Department prints MeeSeva certificates, while the Education Department issues migration certificates to passed candidates.
accepted.tq: Use the department-function pair and reject the swapped-authority trap.
accepted.sec: Mee Seva - meaning, service categories, departments, channels, launch  [APPSC]

accepted.s: MeeSeva was launched in which year in the combined State of Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: MeeSeva was launched in 2011 in the combined State of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the launch year of MeeSeva from the earlier e-Seva year.
accepted.sec: Mee Seva - meaning, service categories, departments, channels, launch  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Through which channels are MeeSeva services delivered?
o: Through franchise centres and the online portal
Through post offices and banks only
accepted.x: MeeSeva services are delivered through MeeSeva franchise centres as well as the online portal.
accepted.tq: Watch for the false exclusivity trap in the word “only.”
accepted.sec: Mee Seva - meaning, service categories, departments, channels, launch  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Apart from service delivery, MeeSeva also functions as an enrolment channel for schemes such as:
accepted.x: MeeSeva also serves as an enrolment channel for schemes such as Aarogya Raksha.
accepted.tq: Distinguish an enrolment function from the platform's ordinary certificate and bill services.
accepted.sec: Mee Seva - meaning, service categories, departments, channels, launch  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Mana Mitra, launched on 30 January 2025, is associated with which department or institution?
accepted.x: Mana Mitra is a WhatsApp-governance initiative launched on 30 January 2025 and run by RTGS.
accepted.tq: Combine the app's launch date with its implementing institution.
accepted.sec: AP citizen and police apps - department + purpose  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT a stated function of the Pura Seva application?
accepted.x: Pura Seva is a Municipal Administration and Urban Development application for grievances, building plan approval and vacant land tax; electricity bills are not its stated function.
accepted.tq: Find the one service belonging outside the municipal-app cluster.
accepted.sec: AP citizen and police apps - department + purpose  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Mana Mitra expanded from how many services in January 2025 to how many services in 2025–26?
accepted.x: Mana Mitra grew from 150 services in January 2025 to 865 services during 2025–26.
accepted.tq: Read the figures as a time sequence, not as independent service counts.

accepted.s: Which of the following services is included among the Mana Mitra services?
accepted.x: Mana Mitra includes services such as rice card eKYC, electricity bills, 1-B Adangal, APSRTC tickets and temple darshan services.
accepted.tq: Recognise the listed citizen-facing service rather than an unrelated government function.

accepted.s: Each Mana Mitra service is capped at which combination of user inputs and documents?
accepted.x: Each Mana Mitra service is limited to five user inputs and two documents.

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding temple services through Mana Mitra is correct?

1. Rs 22.26 crore has been earned by 21 temples since launch.
2. About 30% of darshan and seva bookings are made on WhatsApp.
3. Srikalahasti earned the most among the temples mentioned.

accepted.x: All three statements are correct: 21 temples received Rs 22.26 crore, around 30% of bookings were made through WhatsApp, and Srikalahasti recorded the highest earnings.

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh Cyber Security Policy was formulated in which year, and what is its central objective?
o: 2015; to promote paperless cabinet meetings only
2017; to create a secure cyber ecosystem for citizens, businesses and government
2021; to provide online tendering across departments
2019; to establish municipal service centres only
accepted.x: The AP Cyber Security Policy was formulated in 2017 to establish a secure cyber ecosystem for citizens, businesses and government.
accepted.tq: Link the policy year with its stated broad coverage.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with its NIC product function?
o: MEDHAS — state-wide area networking of mandals
e-Office — paperless office product used in the AP Secretariat and departments
e-Granthalaya — paperless movement of Secretariat files
e-Office — library management with Web OPAC and Unicode
accepted.x: e-Office is NIC's paperless office product used in the AP Secretariat and departments. e-Granthalaya is the library management software with Web OPAC and Unicode features.
accepted.tq: Reject swapped product functions, a common authority-and-purpose trap.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the architecture of e-Pragati?
o: A paperless cabinet platform limited to Himachal Pradesh
A municipal application for vacant land tax only
A whole-of-government architecture with interconnected systems
A single-department portal limited to property registration
accepted.x: e-Pragati is a whole-of-government architecture in which systems are interconnected.
accepted.tq: Distinguish an enterprise architecture from an individual departmental application.
accepted.sec: e-Pragati - state enterprise architecture, packages, cost

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT a core data hub of e-Pragati?
accepted.x: The core e-Pragati data hubs are People Hub, Land Hub, Entity Hub, GIS Hub and IoT Hub; Education Hub is not listed among them.
accepted.tq: Find the outsider in the named-hub list rather than choosing a familiar department.
accepted.sec: e-Pragati - state enterprise architecture, packages, cost

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding e-Pragati:
1. It was built on the Seva model.
2. It integrates Revenue, Registration, Transport and Municipal services in one window.
3. In February 2026, it added 45 more services.
4. Its governance objective is described as faceless, paperless and cashless.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. e-Pragati is based on the Seva model, integrates the four listed service areas, added 45 services in February 2026, and advances faceless, paperless and cashless governance.
accepted.tq: Verify the platform model, integrated departments, dated expansion and governance slogan together.
accepted.sec: e-Pragati - state enterprise architecture, packages, cost
